post.description:
Start here for job discovery and employer comparison by hiring activity. Resolve a city/state with suggest_locations first when you need a location; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the following page. Sponsored cards are mixed in and page composition varies between fetches.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same search. Pass it with the same keyword, location and filters.

easy_apply_only.description: Only jobs that take Glassdoor's Easy Apply (applicationType=1).

employer_id.description:
Only jobs from this Glassdoor employer id (companyId; id from suggest_employers, e.g. 9079 for Google).

Provider reference: minimum 1.

employer_size.description:
Employer size band (employerSizes): 1 = 1-50, 2 = 51-200, 3 = 201-500, 4 = 501-1000, 5 = 1001+ employees.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 5.

industry_id.description:
Glassdoor industry id (industryNId) as listed in the site's industry filter.

Provider reference: minimum 1.

keyword.description: Job title or keywords, e.g. "data analyst" or "registered nurse" (the site's sc.keyword). Must contain a letter or digit.

location_id.description:
Glassdoor location id (location_id from suggest_locations, e.g. 1132348 for New York, NY; 428 for New York State; 1 for the United States). Omit to search the whole United States.

Provider reference: minimum 1.

location_type.description:
Kind of location_id as Glassdoor codes it (location_type from suggest_locations): C city, S state, N country. Default C.

Provider reference: allowed values ["C", "S", "N"]; default "C".

min_rating.description:
Minimum employer overall rating, 1 to 4 stars (minRating).

Provider reference: allowed values ["1", "2", "3", "4"].

min_salary.description:
Annual pay floor in USD (minSalary); the site's UI steps are 40000 to 180000 by 20000, other values are passed through as given.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000000.

posted_within_days.description:
Only jobs posted within the last N days (the site's fromAge filter; its UI offers 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30).

Provider reference: allowed values ["1", "3", "7", "14", "30"].

radius_miles.description:
Search radius around a city location in miles (radius). The site's default is 50 for a city; 0 means the exact location only.

Provider reference: allowed values ["0", "5", "10", "15", "25", "50", "100"].

seniority.description:
Seniority level (seniorityType).

Provider reference: allowed values ["internship", "entrylevel", "midseniorlevel", "director", "executive"].

sort.description:
Result order: the site's relevance (default), newest first (date_desc) or oldest first (date_asc).

Provider reference: allowed values ["relevance", "date_desc", "date_asc"].

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Search Glassdoor US jobs by keyword, optionally within a Glassdoor location (location_id + location_type from suggest_locations; omitted means the whole United States), one page of up to 30 job cards: listing id, title, employer (id, name, short name, overall rating), job location, pay range (p10/p50/p90 with currency, period and whether the employer stated it or Glassdoor estimated it), posting age in days, Easy Apply and sponsored flags, the job page URL and the search snippet. Also returns the total match count, the filters the site applied (including the default radius) and related job titles. Page 1 comes from the public SEO result page (/Job/jobs.htm names the canonical /Job/<slug>-SRCH_... URL, which is fetched with the filters); next_cursor continues through the job-search BFF (jobSearchResultsQuery) with the page cursors the site issues. Filters: posted_within_days, remote_only, easy_apply_only, sort, min_salary, min_rating, seniority, radius_miles, employer_size, employer_id, industry_id.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `jobs` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `age_days` | number | Days since the posting, as the site reports (0 = today). |
| `easy_apply` | boolean |  |
| `employer` | object |  |
| `listing_id` | number | Glassdoor job listing id (the jl= parameter of the job URL). |
| `location` | object |  |
| `normalized_title` | string | Glassdoor's normalized occupation for the title (goc), e.g. "data analyst". |
| `pay` | object | Pay range the card shows (10th/50th/90th percentile); null when the card shows none. |
| `snippet` | string | The description fragment the result card shows; null when the card has none. |
| `sponsored` | boolean | Paid placement (isSponsoredJob). |
| `title` | string |  |
| `url` | string | The job's Glassdoor page (seoJobLink). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
